findings.why: The receipt-N enumeration skips N=6 while the same bullet's own cited `inventory :83-108` records six legs at r10-2 (`tools/mutate-and-run.sh:84` reads `r4-2; r7-1 leg ledger; r10-2 six legs; r16 seven; r18 eight; r26 nine; r51 ten`) and the page itself quotes six-leg receipts (`REGRESSION: PASS (cases=6 passed=6; ...)` at SKILL.md:1364 and :1452, and the registry row at SKILL.md:1415 says `six-leg registry at round 11, seven since round 16`), so a reader citing a six-leg receipt has no N in this list to check it against.
